text.text_excerpt: ORC is one more example of how NOLA is transforming into "Seattle of the South", when it comes to great neighborhood coffee shops. I don't frequent this stretch of Esplanade, so while passing through on our way to Floats in the Oaks, and in need of a coffee, I was pleased to see the sign on Esplanade directing me a half block downriver on N Johnson Street. Lovely shop, with a very friendly shopkeeper/barista. Great space. Great vibe. Plenty of room to socially distance. Masks required, of course. Hand sanitizer available. Decided on a hot mocha latte on this chilly afternoon. Great drink, with the proper amount of Ghirardelli chocolate to keep it from being too sweet. I'll be back!

Needed to get some work done and was in the neighborhood so I swung by. This is a true neighborhood coffee shop which was pretty cool. Came in for a cold brew and they feature different roasters based on the purpose of the coffee use. There's plenty of space inside with ample seating space which was great. Spent an hour at their workstation bar which I thoroughly enjoyed. For those who are hungry they also offer baked goods and savory bites.

I had a great experience here. The barista was very friendly and helpful. I got a matcha latte and yummy breakfast burrito. They are able to heat up the food for you which is a plus. I loved the space. There are tons of places to sit and do work. They also have tables outside to enjoy your coffee. I can't wait to come here again.
